content: The US Department of Transportation finalized its plans today to weaken fuel efficiency standards, calling it “among the largest deregulatory actions under the second Trump Administration.” It’s a nail in the coffin for Biden-era standards that would have required fleet average fuel economy to reach 50.4 miles per gallon by model year 2031. President Donald Trump’s plan requires 34.9 miles per gallon, not much higher than the 30.1-mile-per-gallon target previously set for model year 2024. The Trump administration claims its plan would shave $1,300 off the average cost of a new vehicle, saving $138 billion over the next five years — though those figures have been disputed.  Automakers are pretty happy with the new rules. But consumer advocacy, health, and environmental groups are incensed. They argue that weaker fuel economy standards will wind up making Americans pay more at the pump, on top of increased healthcare costs and damages from climate change due to air pollution. The Biden administration’s standards that Trump trashed were expected to save $23 billion in fuel costs, and a car owner more than $600 in gasoline over the lifetime of a vehicle. “For decades, fuel economy standards have ensured that new cars, SUVs and pickup trucks are more efficient, which saves lives and money,” the American Lung Association’s president and CEO, Harold Wimmer, said in an emailed statement. “There is no reason to weaken standards that are technologically feasible and have a direct benefit for the quality of the air people breathe.”

chineseContent: 美国交通部今天敲定了削弱燃油效率标准的计划，称其为“特朗普第二届政府期间最大规模的放松管制行动之一”。这对拜登时代的标准来说是一个致命的打击，该标准要求到 2031 年车型年车队平均燃油经济性达到每加仑 50.4 英里。唐纳德·特朗普总统的计划要求每加仑行驶 34.9 英里，比之前为 2024 年车型年设定的每加仑 30.1 英里的目标高不了多少。特朗普政府声称其计划将使一辆新车的平均成本减少 1,300 美元，从而节省成本未来五年将达到 1380 亿美元——尽管这些数字存在争议。  汽车制造商对新规则非常满意。但消费者权益保护组织、健康组织和环保组织却被激怒了。他们认为，较弱的燃油经济性标准最终将使美国人在加油时支付更高的费用，此外，医疗费用也会增加，空气污染导致的气候变化也会造成损害。特朗普废除的拜登政府标准预计将节省 230 亿美元的燃料成本，并为车主在车辆的使用寿命内节省 600 多美元的汽油。美国肺脏协会主席兼首席执行官 Harold Wimmer 在一份电子邮件声明中表示：“几十年来，燃油经济性标准确保了新车、SUV 和皮卡车更加高效，从而挽救了生命和金钱。” “没有理由削弱技术上可行且对人们呼吸的空气质量有直接好处的标准。”
